name: claude-handoff-kit
description: Harness Engineering kit: file-based handoffs that coordinate a planning agent and an implementer.

plugins.name: handoff-kit
plugins.description: File-based handoffs between a planning agent (Opus) and an implementer (Codex or a fresh Claude). Ships the /plan /clarify /resume /implement /dispatch /archive /handoff-init commands plus optional enforcement hooks.

plugins.name: handoff-kit-django
plugins.description: Optional Django layer: domain skills (patterns, security, TDD, verification) and reviewer subagents (python/security/database) imported from ECC, plus the /django-review command that wires them into the /implement fresh-context gate.
